metadata.description: Apogee — personal fork of the Claude Code Development Kit (CCDK). Per-project install of the workflow machinery (durable docs context, br issue memory, git-flow conventions, two safety hooks) plus the prime/plan/run-plan/merge/release entry points and the docs/apogee doc loop.

plugins.name: apogee
plugins.description: Claude Code workflow machinery: lifecycle hooks (secret scan + the production-branch wall, plus context injectors), workflow skills (update-docs, review-work, second-opinion, public-docs, readme, symfony-cli-workflow, ai-clean-room, br, git-commit, git-flow), and the init/prime/plan-feature/start/finish/release/run-plan entry-point skills. Install once, enable per project.
